weakness: No MFA on the comparative rater and 2 insurer portals; email and banking use phishable text codes
source: P07 assessment (IA-02(02)); P03 G-029 (314.4(c)(5) benchmark); Carrier DSA
remediation_plan: Turn on rater MFA; authenticator app or security key for email and banking and remove text codes as a sign-in method; written request to the 2 insurers for MFA or AMS single sign-on
milestones: 2026-09-21 rater MFA and email authenticator on; 2026-09-30 banking moved and insurer requests sent
resources_required: Owner time (2 hours); two security keys about $60

weakness: Bookkeeper signs in to online banking with the owner's identity
source: P07 assessment (IA-02 objectives); P03 G-015 (626.561(1)), G-024
remediation_plan: View-only bank sub-user for the bookkeeper; change the owner's banking password; owner-only payment rights; alerts on every transfer and new payee
milestones: 2026-09-18 sub-user created; 2026-09-30 owner password changed and alerts on

weakness: Mailbox rules, sign-ins, and AMS activity never reviewed; outside forwarding allowed
source: P07 assessment (AU-06 objectives); P03 G-033 (314.4(c)(8) benchmark)
remediation_plan: Block forwarding to outside addresses; turn on new-rule and new sign-in alerts; monthly review checklist; weekly review for 3 months after any incident or near miss
milestones: 2026-09-21 forwarding blocked and alerts on; 2026-10-01 first monthly review; 2026-10-31 checklist in use

weakness: Client documents travel as plain email attachments and texts; ID photos stored on the phone
remediation_plan: Turn on the AMS client upload portal and secure links; client notice; upload and delete the 9 texted ID photos; remote wipe on the phone
milestones: 2026-09-30 photos uploaded and deleted; 2026-10-31 portal live and client notice sent

weakness: Saved and reused passwords; default router password; no lost-phone procedure; shared banking credential unchanged since 2023
remediation_plan: Password manager with unique passphrases; clear the browser store; new router admin password; lost-phone steps and recovery codes in the sealed envelope (POL-01 7.6)
milestones: 2026-09-30 password manager in use and router password changed; 2026-12-31 sealed envelope delivered

weakness: No vendor list; bookkeeper and AI chatbot hold client data with no security terms; only the AMS vendor monitored
source: P07 assessment (SA-09 objectives); P03 G-012, G-040, G-041
remediation_plan: Vendor list; confidentiality and security terms with the bookkeeper (including 10-day breach notice); delete the chatbot history and stop use (P10); review e-signature and rater vendors
milestones: 2026-09-30 chatbot stopped and history deleted; 2026-10-31 bookkeeper terms signed and vendor list complete

weakness: Email and files kept only 30 days; no AMS export; security documents without backup
source: P07 assessment (CP-09a. and CP-09c.); P03 G-017 (626.748)
remediation_plan: Email and file backup service with 1-year retention; quarterly encrypted AMS export
milestones: 2026-10-31 backup service on; 2026-12-31 first AMS export verified

weakness: Retired laptop and leased printer-scanner hold client data; no sanitization method
remediation_plan: IT consultant wipes the retired laptop and clears the printer-scanner storage before the lease return; certified drive destruction for anything that cannot be wiped; disposal log
milestones: 2026-10-31 both devices sanitized and logged (before the 2026-11-30 lease return)

weakness: No review or update cycle for the risk assessment
source: P07 assessment (RA-03d. and RA-03f.); P03 G-023
remediation_plan: POL-01 4.3 sets an annual August review and change triggers; first update August 2027
